resources.string: Demo mode: this is fake data. Turn it off in Settings.
This reading is old. Check your Dexcom app.

GlucoVoice is not a medical device and is not made or endorsed by Dexcom. Readings come from your Dexcom Share account and can be delayed or missing. Always confirm on your Dexcom app or a blood glucose meter before making a treatment decision.
Log in with the Dexcom account you use in the G6 or G7 app (not a follower account). The login is checked with Dexcom, then stored encrypted on this phone only.
Speak my glucose whenever the app opens
Demo mode (fake data, no Dexcom account needed)
Login worked, but Dexcom Share returned no readings from the last 24 hours. In the Dexcom app, make sure Share is on and that you have at least one follower.
Enter your Dexcom username and password, or turn on demo mode.

Dexcom Share must be turned on in the Dexcom app, and it needs at least one follower before Dexcom\'s servers receive your data. A family member, or a second free Dexcom account, works as the follower.
Your latest glucose. Tap to hear it.
